tasks.title: Monorepo and tooling scaffolding
tasks.description: npm workspaces for backend and frontend, env examples, dev Postgres via docker-compose.
tasks.details: Root package.json with workspaces (backend, frontend). .env.example for both. docker-compose.yml with postgis/postgis image. Dev scripts: dev:api, dev:web, db:up/down/migrate/seed.
tasks.testStrategy: npm install resolves both workspaces; docker-compose config validates.

tasks.title: Backend foundation (Fastify + TypeScript)
tasks.description: App skeleton, zod-validated config, Postgres pool, SQL migration runner, error handling, health check.
tasks.details: Fastify 5, strict tsconfig (ESM NodeNext). config.ts validates env. db/pool.ts. db/migrate.ts runs SQL files with a _migrations table. /health reports db + routing status.

tasks.title: Data model and PostGIS schema
tasks.description: Migrations for users, access_keys, organizations, protests (LineString route), parking, device_tokens.
tasks.details: 001_init.sql (users approved/admin only, access_keys, orgs, protests with geometry(LineString,4326) + GiST, protest_organizations). 002_parking.sql (device_tokens, parking_spots, parking_chips as Point geometry with GiST + live index). Bilingual EN/ES nullable fields. Seed script with sample San Juan protests.
tasks.testStrategy: Migrations apply cleanly on a fresh PostGIS db; seed inserts admin + sample protests.

tasks.title: Auth: access keys, login, JWT roles, anonymous device tokens
tasks.description: Organizer registration via single-use access key, login, JWT role guard, and anonymous per-device tokens for pins.
tasks.details: register-with-key redeems sha256-hashed key to role approved. login with bcrypt. @fastify/jwt with requireRole. Public has NO account; anonymous device tokens (POST /api/devices, x-device-token header) attribute community pins without email/password.
tasks.testStrategy: Register + login issue JWTs; device token mint + resolve works; role guard blocks unauthorized writes.

tasks.title: Protest CRUD and calendar export
tasks.description: Create/patch (organizer/admin), public list and detail, per-protest .ics download.
tasks.details: POST/PATCH /api/protests (transactional, orgs, bilingual fields). GET list (active/upcoming) and detail with organizers + links. GET /api/protests/:id/calendar.ics plus Google Calendar render link.
tasks.testStrategy: CRUD round-trips; list/detail serialize bilingual with fallback; .ics validates.

tasks.title: Route-conflict match engine
tasks.description: POST /api/protests/match: OpenRouteService routing plus PostGIS conflict detection and avoid-polygon reroute.
tasks.details: Server calls ORS for primary + alternative routes. ST_DWithin conflict query against approved upcoming protests. If all alternatives conflict, build ST_Buffer + ST_Union avoid polygon and re-request via ORS avoid_polygons. Returns full protest context + suggested route + calendar links. Provider isolated to lib/routing.ts.
tasks.testStrategy: Given a route crossing a seeded protest, returns conflict + a clean suggested route.

tasks.title: Legal parking, community pins, abuse guards
tasks.description: Merged legal parking (curated + OSM), ephemeral community pins, rate limiting, and coarse location presence check.
tasks.details: GET /api/parking merges admin-curated spots with live OSM Overpass (cached, best-effort). Pins: POST/GET/taken/delete keyed on device token, TTL auto-expiry in query. Rate limiting per device + per IP. Coarse IP-vs-coordinates presence check via local geoip-lite (fail-open, no third-party calls). Formerly called chips; user-facing name is Pins / Marcadores.
tasks.testStrategy: Pins drop/take/expire correctly; rate limit returns 429; cross-continent IP is rejected, localhost fails open.

tasks.title: Frontend foundation (Vite React PWA shell)
tasks.description: Bilingual PWA shell with theming, typed API client, and the protest list.
tasks.details: Vite 7 + React + TS. vite-plugin-pwa (manifest, service worker, protest-list runtime cache). react-i18next EN/ES. CSS custom-property theming with data-theme light/dark. Framework-agnostic src/lib (api client, types) for a future React Native port. Protest list + card.
tasks.testStrategy: vite build clean; language + theme toggles work; protest list renders.

tasks.title: Provision infrastructure and keys
tasks.description: Stand up Postgres+PostGIS, get an OpenRouteService key, and a MapLibre map style URL.
tasks.details: Local Docker PostGIS for dev (or managed: Supabase/Neon, confirm PostGIS). Free ORS hosted key set as ORS_API_KEY, or self-hosted via ORS_BASE_URL. MapLibre vector style URL (MapTiler/Stadia/Protomaps) for VITE_MAP_STYLE_URL. Decide JWT secret handling.
tasks.testStrategy: docker compose up starts PostGIS; ORS key returns a route; map style URL loads tiles.

tasks.title: Run and verify the backend end-to-end
tasks.description: Migrate, seed, and hit every endpoint against a live PostGIS instance.
tasks.details: npm run db:up, db:migrate, db:seed. Verify auth, protest CRUD, /match (with ORS key), parking, pins (device token, rate limit, presence). This is the first real runtime check; the backend currently only typechecks.
tasks.testStrategy: All endpoints return expected shapes against live DB; match returns a real reroute; pins expire.

tasks.title: Discovery-first frontend: marches feed, detail, RSVP
tasks.description: Build the participation-forward core: marches feed as home, protest detail, and I'm going / share / add-to-calendar.
tasks.details: App emphasis is finding and joining protests; routing/avoidance is secondary. Marches feed is the default screen. Protest detail leads with RSVP (I'm going + going count), share, add-to-calendar, then cause/goal/organizers/links. Bilingual EN/ES, light/dark, no em dashes in copy. Matches the approved Ruta Libre mockup.
tasks.testStrategy: Feed lists seeded protests; detail RSVP toggles; calendar + share work; both languages and themes render.

tasks.title: MapLibre map and route/match UI (secondary)
tasks.description: Getting-there flow: map, origin/destination input, and the conflict + reroute experience.
tasks.details: MapLibre GL with VITE_MAP_STYLE_URL. Current-location + destination input. Show conflict explanation (join or route around), protest context, suggested route on the map. Framed as a secondary utility, not the headline.
tasks.testStrategy: Entering a route that crosses a protest shows the conflict UI and a drawn alternate route.

tasks.title: Parking and pins UI (geolocation)
tasks.description: Nearby legal parking list plus drop/take community pins via device geolocation.
tasks.details: Use my location -> nearby legal parking + live pins. Drop a pin at current GPS; mark taken (removes for everyone); pins expire in 90 min. First-run anonymous device-token bootstrap (POST /api/devices, stored on device). Poll for live updates. Works without the map.
tasks.testStrategy: Drop/take/expire round-trips against the live backend; device token persists across reloads.

tasks.title: First-run disclosure modal
tasks.description: Bilingual one-woman-project disclosure shown once on first open.
tasks.details: Modal on first launch: this is a one-woman project, info comes from organizations and may lag, refer to official announcements, still in development. EN/ES with its own language toggle. Remembered per device so it does not nag returning users. Copy already drafted in the mockup.
tasks.testStrategy: Shows on first visit, dismisses with I understand, does not reappear after acknowledgement.

tasks.title: Organizer registration and login screens
tasks.description: Access-key registration and login UI for organizers (the only real accounts).
tasks.details: Screens for register-with-key and login. Only organizers/admins have accounts; the public never signs up. Store JWT, gate protest create/patch behind it. Keep this flow separate and low-profile relative to the public discovery experience.
tasks.testStrategy: Valid access key registers an organizer; login persists a session; protected actions require it.

tasks.title: PWA offline and polish
tasks.description: Offline caching of last-fetched protests, install prompt, loading/empty/error states, accessibility pass.
tasks.details: Service worker + storage to keep the last protest list available offline. Add to Home Screen affordance. Consistent loading, empty, and error states. Accessibility and basic unit tests for match logic and auth.
tasks.testStrategy: App loads last protests offline; installable; a11y checks pass; core unit tests green.

tasks.title: Deploy
tasks.description: Host backend + managed Postgres/PostGIS, static-host the frontend, secrets, CORS, rate limiting, CI.
tasks.details: Backend hosting with managed PostGIS. Frontend static host (Vercel/Netlify) with env-injected map key. Production CORS, rate limiting on public endpoints, secrets management, and CI (build + test). Move in-memory rate limiter to a shared store if running more than one instance.
tasks.testStrategy: Public URL serves the app; endpoints work in prod; CI runs build + tests on push.

metadata.description: protest-tracker (Ruta Libre): find and join protests in San Juan, with route-conflict warnings and community parking pins. Backend built and typechecked; remaining work is live verification and the discovery-first frontend.
